title: Potion
summary: Klein drinks the Seer potion and formally begins the Seer pathway.

title: Meeting the Monster Again
summary: Klein explicitly recognizes that the Seer potion has been fully digested.

title: Messenger
summary: Daly explicitly validates Klein's use of the acting method and his self-developed Seer principles.

title: Clown Potion
summary: Klein drinks the Clown potion and advances to Sequence 8.

title: New Abilities
summary: He tests the Clown's major physical changes: balance, coordination, agility, speed and predictive combat intuition.

title: Lanevus confrontation
summary: After killing Lanevus, the emotional contradiction behind the smiling clown becomes the point where the Clown potion finishes digesting.

title: Magician
summary: Klein advances to Sequence 7 Magician and begins testing the new spell-like toolkit.

title: Conjectures
summary: He consolidates the five Magician principles, including preparation, challenging the impossible, proactive performance, audience feedback and attention control.

title: The Scapegoat
summary: The Magician potion reaches complete digestion by the end of this chapter's sequence of events.

title: Faceless
summary: Klein advances to Faceless, gaining the ability to reconstruct appearance and support much deeper identity work.

title: Lord Caucasian
summary: Acting as Wendt helps Klein sharpen the Faceless principle that disguise requires genuine feedback without losing the core self.

title: Final Faceless digestion
summary: While operating as Gehrman Sparrow on the sea, Klein explicitly feels the Faceless potion complete its digestion.

title: Every Second Counts
summary: Klein completes the mermaid-song ritual and advances to Marionettist.

title: Spirit Body Threads
summary: He begins directly applying Spirit Body Thread control, the foundation of creating and commanding marionettes.

title: Movement of the Night
summary: Klein explicitly confirms the Marionettist principle of remaining behind the scenes and letting marionettes act in his place.

title: Things to Take Note Of
summary: The foggy-town events reinforce the principle that each marionette should possess a distinct identity and believable setting.

title: Ince Zangwill climax
summary: Klein's orchestrated grand performance surrounding Ince Zangwill completes enough Marionettist digestion for immediate advancement.

title: A Bestowment Or A Curse
summary: Klein consumes the Bizarro Sorcerer potion after completing the demigod-level performance ritual and becomes a demigod.

title: Possibility
summary: He deliberately incorporates bizarre and eerie behavior into his methods to satisfy the potion's acting requirements while avoiding harm to innocents.

title: Haunted Tales
summary: Klein creates frightening urban legends while healing bombing victims, using public feedback to accelerate Bizarro Sorcerer digestion.

title: Spirit Channeling
summary: His deliberate Amon impersonation before the Red Angel evil spirit becomes an extreme example of Bizarro Sorcerer acting through shock and fear.

title: Amidst History
summary: Klein uses his unique separation from the present era to satisfy the Scholar of Yore ritual and advances to Sequence 3.

title: Scholar of Yore
summary: He begins exploring the Historical Void and the pathway's ability to borrow and summon from the past.

title: When the Stars Are Right
summary: The Chernobyl revelation confirms the world's true ancient history and causes the Scholar of Yore potion to finish digesting.

title: Miracle Invoker
summary: Klein returns a lost piece of history to the present and advances to Sequence 2 Miracle Invoker.

title: The Power of Wishes
summary: He discovers the operating rule of Wishes: larger miracles depend on accumulating fulfilled wishes step by step.

title: An Unknown City
summary: Klein states that he has concluded the Miracle Invoker acting principles while continuing the wandering-magician approach.

title: Seizing The Opportunity
summary: Immediately before advancing to Sequence 1, Klein grants accumulated wishes and finishes the last portion of Miracle Invoker digestion.

title: Attendant of Mysteries
summary: Klein completes the marionette-town ritual and advances to Sequence 1, with his body and Worms of Spirit temporarily dissolving into the spirit world.

title: Urgency
summary: He identifies the three most important new powers: Regenerate, Reassembly/Tampering (which he prefers to call Grafting), and Realm of Mysteries.

title: Urgency
summary: Klein determines how to reach a fully digested Attendant state and begins solving the Fool ritual problem of fooling time, history or fate.

title: Magical Mushroom
summary: Klein confirms from the Fool Card that Sequence 0 of the pathway is The Fool.

title: Urgency
summary: He actively analyzes how the apotheosis ritual could fool history, time or fate and explores using Sefirah Castle to make the deception real.

title: A Miracle
summary: Klein attempts and completes the contested apotheosis process that makes him Sequence 0 The Fool.
